value.rationale: The canonical full-flag incidence system of finite projective geometry receives a complete uniform classification of every shattered support, all Gaussian-multinomial coefficients in two natural parameters, and its exact online mistake-tree dimension. The shattering-complex identification with the spherical building and the q-to-one link reveal structural geometry and combinatorics beyond a scalar VC bound, in the context of actively studied flag codes. Known building topology and ordinary Gaussian chain counts are explicitly acknowledged as prior facts.
